tools.name: abort_task
tools.description: Skip an armed task: not this time; the loop moves on. The task is unarmed and its abortions count goes up by 1. On a task that is not armed it changes nothing.

tools.name: arm_all
tools.description: Run the arming pass the user asked for, in the user's time zone. 1) A scheduled "drop" task still armed from an earlier day is skipped automatically (missed); one armed today is kept; "reschedule" tasks stay armed. 2) Arms every active scheduled task due today that is not armed, except one the user

tools.name: check_task
tools.description: Mark an armed task as done: it is unarmed and its ticker goes up by 1. On a task that is not armed it changes nothing (compare ticker before and after).

tools.name: create_loop
tools.description: Create an empty loop (a queue of tasks). Add tasks with enqueue_task.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task. A "schedule" task needs exactly one of dow, cron or every_days. To put a task in a loop, create it with task_type "loop", then call enqueue_task.

tools.name: delete_loop
tools.description: Delete a loop for good (its tasks are kept). Cannot be undone: confirm with the user first.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task for good, with its history (ticker, abortions). Cannot be undone: confirm with the user first.

tools.name: dequeue_task
tools.description: Remove a task from a loop's queue (the task itself is kept).

tools.name: enqueue_task
tools.description: Append one of the user's tasks to the end of a loop's queue.

tools.name: get_loop
tools.description: Get one loop with its ordered queue of tasks.

tools.name: list_loops
tools.description: List all loops in the user's DoLoop account, each with its ordered queue of tasks and current_task_id.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List all tasks in the user's DoLoop account (every type, armed or not).

tools.name: todays_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks that are armed (due) right now: what the user has to do today.

tools.name: update_loop
tools.description: Change a loop's fields. Only the fields you pass change; their previous values are overwritten.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Change a task's fields. Only the fields you pass change; their previous values are overwritten.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "arm_all" is 769 chars, far longer than this server's median (93). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
